sentences.text: Ser Gregor Clegane , nicknamed The Mountain , is a fictional character in the A Song of Ice and Fire series of fantasy novels by American author George R. R. Martin , and its television adaptation Game of Thrones .	A Song of Ice and Fire	A Song of Ice and Fire	Game of Thrones	Game of Thrones	George R. R. Martin	George R. R. Martin	fictional character	fictional character	fantasy	fantasy
He is a retainer to House Lannister .	House Lannister	House Lannister
An enormous man , he is well known for his size , prowess in battle and cruelty .

Introduced in 1996 's A Game of Thrones , Gregor is the older brother of Sandor Clegane , from the fictional kingdom of Westeros .	Game of Thrones	Game of Thrones	A Game of Thrones	A Game of Thrones	Sandor Clegane	Sandor Clegane	Westeros	Westeros

He subsequently appeared in Martin 's A Clash of Kings -LRB- 1998 -RRB- , A Storm of Swords -LRB- 2000 -RRB- and in A Dance with Dragons -LRB- 2011 -RRB- as Ser Robert Strong .	A Clash of Kings	A Clash of Kings	A Storm of Swords	A Storm of Swords	A Dance with Dragons	A Dance with Dragons
Ser Gregor Clegane is a huge knight and the elder brother of Sandor Clegane .	Sandor Clegane	Sandor Clegane	knight	knight
Called `` The Mountain That Rides '' , he is known for his incredibly cruel nature and uncontrollable temper .
His size and strength make him a fearsome warrior , and he has earned a reputation for cruelty and brutality .
He is able to wield a two-handed sword one handed .
When they were children , Gregor shoved Sandor 's face into a brazier , gruesomely scarring him .

Gregor Clegane is portrayed by Conan Stevens in season one , by Ian Whyte in season two , and by Hafþór Júlíus Björnsson in seasons four , five , and six in the HBO television adaptation .
